_doc: Path-parity matrix. Every optimization or capability, on every serving path where it applies: engaged (with evidence), na (with reason), partial/missing (with owner and impact). tests/unit/test_path_parity.py enforces it; see that test for the rules. A new optimization module or performance setting fails CI until it has a row here.

paths.mtp: Qwen3.5-family single-request speculative lane, MTP head (mtp_lane.py)
paths.dflash: Qwen3.5-family single-request speculative lane, DFlash2 drafter: chain, copy islands, fast tree (dflash_*.py)
paths.driver: RoundDriver multi-row packed forwards (round_driver/, YUNSHU_ROUND_DRIVER, experimental, default off)
paths.batch: Stock shared batch on the VLM runner: spec off (concurrent rows, ineligible requests, spec disabled)
paths.generic: Other mlx-vlm families on the generic runner (Gemma, Qwen4/Flash-Next, Omni thinker, ...)
paths.loop: Legacy EngineCore loop (YUNSHU_ENGINE_LOOP, experimental, not grown)

exclusions.a: logits processors (penalties, logit_bias, min_tokens, suppress, top_n_sigma)
exclusions.why: A penalty is a function of the committed history; a verify window can apply it row by row with cumulative counts through the draft tokens. Nothing fundamental.
The driver already forces the closing token per row; the lane can truncate the accepted run at the budget.
XTC is stateful per draw (random exclusion), no position-keyed form. Rare; keep.

ev: int8 KV keeps the upstream path
exclusions.why: driver slot buffers are bf16; a quantized slot format is work, not a contradiction.
prompt embeddings with mrope positions are not packed by round_driver/forward.py.
A rotating cache cannot be restored at an arbitrary boundary; checkpoints at window-safe boundaries are possible (apcomni).

duplicates.note: Three draft top-k/argmax readouts over the 248k head: DraftVocab (MTP greedy), compute_lattice_gpu argpartition (DFlash), mtp_tree argpartition (MTP tree).
duplicates.unify: One DraftReadout(hidden) -> (argmax | topk(k)) owned by the target head; every drafter calls it; DraftVocab becomes its restricted implementation.

duplicates.note: Context lookup proposers: copy_drafter (VLM lane, shared by MTP and DFlash), ngram/suffix/gpu_ngram (text path and loop). Different matching rules, cost model and acceptance statistics.
duplicates.unify: A Proposer protocol (propose(tokens, k) -> list[int], observe(accepted)) with copy_drafter as the implementation; text path gains it and drops ngram_proposer.

duplicates.note: Three draft-depth controllers: NodeBudget (lane trees/DFlash chain), TensorFold allocate (driver), adaptive_spec (legacy loop). MTP chain has none.
duplicates.unify: One expected-tokens-per-ms allocator (allocate.py form handles 1..n rows); the lane calls it with n=1.

duplicates.note: Three MTP head round implementations (lane, driver, standalone EXPERIMENTAL backend); upstream mlx_vlm _mtp_rounds_batch is a fourth reference.
duplicates.unify: Driver generalizes the lane (rows >= 1); delete the lane and the standalone backend when the driver passes the decide= gate.

duplicates.note: Four verify/decode forwards for the same Qwen3.5 layers with their own GDN and attention handling.
duplicates.unify: One packed row forward parameterized by window shape (chain, tree, ragged rows).

duplicates.note: Two prefix-cache stacks (VLM APC with WARM/SSD tiers vs text prefix/SSD cache) and two disk-cache setting families (YUNSHU_VLM_APC_DISK* vs YUNSHU_SSD_CACHE*); the driver adds a third namespace inside APC.
duplicates.unify: Text path moves to APC (the CLAUDE.md plan for unifying text onto the runner); one disk setting family.

duplicates.note: Two KV-quantization stacks and settings: YUNSHU_KV_QUANT_BITS (text) and YUNSHU_KV_PRECISION (VLM).
duplicates.unify: One user setting; ragged_kv's int8 layout becomes the format for both.

duplicates.note: top-p/min-p/XTC/top-k filter chains re-implemented in RowSampler.__call__, driver._sample, keyed_sampling.filter_logprobs, engine_sampling and batch_sampler.
duplicates.unify: keyed_sampling.filter_logprobs as the only chain; RowSampler and driver call it.

duplicates.note: Penalty / logit_bias / min_tokens / suppress processors written twice (engine_fast _rep_penalty/_freq_pres_penalty/_logit_bias_proc/_suppress_proc/_min_tokens_proc vs build_penalty_processors + TokenMaskProcessor).
duplicates.unify: One processor set with a verify-window (multi-row) form; both paths and speculation use it.

duplicates.note: _tool_guide / validate_forced_tools copy-pasted between the fast path and VLMEngine.
duplicates.unify: Move to tool_call_grammar.py as one function taking a tokenizer.

duplicates.note: Three budget implementations: thinking_budget.py (text), mlx_vlm ThinkingBudgetCriteria (runner), driver force list.
duplicates.unify: One state machine in thinking_budget.py with a 'forced next token' query.

duplicates.note: omni_engine drives mlx-lm generate_step directly (own loop), outside the runner's APC / spec / cancel handling.
duplicates.unify: Route the Omni thinker through the runner (apcomni owns the APC restore).
